summary: Scale autonomy through explicit risk tiers and measured promotion, not one global 'YOLO' switch.

items.text: Define action classes with maximum blast radius, required evidence, permitted credentials, network destinations and approval owner.
Promote an agent to wider rails only after shadow runs and canary tasks meet calibrated success, incident and recovery thresholds.
Continuously inject adversarial and failure scenarios into non-production environments to verify that containment and rollback still work.
